title: drift reader output
description: What a kind's drift reader module returns (#5068), the same answer a lexicon's readDrift gives chant lifecycle drift (ReadDriftResult in @intentius/chant/drift-record, DriftReaderOutput in @intentius/chant/workspace/drift-reader). Either the lines of each read the reader ran, in order, as the drift record's NDJSON stream has them (a drift-start, its drift-record lines and a drift-settle per read, each line one of drift.schema.json's $defs/line), or a refusal with a code chant workspace drift prints. A read that ran and failed is not a refusal: its addresses are records with status not-observed. chant workspace drift renames every line's member to the workspace member and places each record on the member's graph. First read by chant 0.124.96.

lines.description: The stream lines, in order. An empty list is a read that found nothing to report.

code.description: read-unsupported for a --read or --stack the reader has not got, resource-unsupported for --resource on a reader that cannot read one resource on its own, no-drift-read when there is nothing to read (ReadDriftRefusalCode).
